title: Google Chrome adds Gemini-powered scam detection, warns users of ClickFix attacks
description: Google Chrome is introducing new scam detection features powered by Gemini technology to identify deceptive websites and warn users about suspicious commands copied from ClickFix attacks. This enhancement aims to protect users from phishing and social engineering threats by providing real-time alerts within the browser.
aiSummary: Google Chrome is implementing scam protections that leverage Gemini to detect deceptive websites. Additionally, it warns users when they copy suspicious commands associated with ClickFix attacks, which are social engineering tactics designed to trick users into executing harmful commands. These protections are integrated into the browser to enhance user safety against phishing and scam attempts.
aiImpact: The new protections reduce the risk of users falling victim to phishing scams and social engineering attacks involving deceptive websites and malicious command copying. By warning users proactively, Chrome helps prevent potential compromise or misuse of user systems through ClickFix attack vectors.
